_comment: NWPS sample points moved by hand, keyed by spot slug. apply_nwps_assignments writes nwps_node_lat/lng from here (and the distance from the spot) in place of the node in scripts/nwps_okx_assignments.json, so a re-bake from that file keeps the move. 'replaces' is the node the move was measured against: if the assignment ever names a different node (the spot was re-placed), apply_nwps_assignments stops rather than override a placement nobody measured. Each new node is a CG1 grid cell centre on the spot's own WFO grid. Evidence: sw1-raycast run 50 (mode face-seaward, commit 133cde0, 2026-10-27), artifact face-seaward-50, saved under docs/face_validation/run-50/ on claude/practical-dirac-bshfbr-face; each cell is the nearest NWPS cell at least 10 m deep (ETOPO 2022) within 30 deg of the spot's facing, read from the same 6 NOMADS cycles as the current point. The Hatteras three (rodanthe, salvo, s-turns) are from sw1-raycast run 58 (mode nwps-cells, commit e244d2a, 2026-10-29), artifact nwps-cells-58, saved under docs/face_validation/run-58/: there ETOPO puts the current points in 10 to 13 m, so depth alone would keep them; each new cell is the nearest within 30 deg of the facing that is at least 10 m deep at its centre AND whose NWPS Hs is at least 0.9 of the cell one column further seaward in every cycle read. Bandon Beach, Moonstone Beach Humboldt, Short Sands Beach York, Revere Beach, Hubbard Creek and Galveston Seawall are from sw1-raycast run 67 (mode nwps-cells, commit bf3ca68, 2026-11-06), artifact nwps-cells-67, saved under docs/face_validation/run-67/, with run 66 (mode nwps-blank) for the hours each current cell is blank: the same rule as the Hatteras three, and the new cell must also be wet (an Hs, period and direction) in every hour of every cycle read. After run 68 (mode node-preview), where its first qualifying cell read over 1.15 of its neighbour, Galveston Seawall shares 61st Street Galveston's cell instead, which is wet every hour but outside the rule. Point Lookout is held at its placed cell: in run 68 its first qualifying cell read 1.163 of Lido Beach and Jones Beach, and in run 69 the qualifying cell beside it read 1.191 (docs/face_validation/run-69/).
